question: Should core Skill Workshop permanently expose canonical proposal review and bind pending-approval lifecycle decisions to the reviewed proposal version?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven, but this is a new core tool/CLI and approval contract with intentional compatibility behavior; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want that permanent product surface.

options.title: Adopt the core contract
options.body: Accept review, bounded pagination, and fail-closed snapshot binding while retaining compatible ID-only direct lifecycle calls.

options.title: Narrow to preview only
options.body: Keep canonical read-only previews but defer approval-version binding until its compatibility behavior is separately approved.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Continue using summary-only approvals and close or park the paired feature request until the core surface is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Adopt the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept review, bounded pagination, and fail-closed snapshot binding while retaining compatible ID-only direct lifecycle calls.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the existing Skill Workshop policy, approval, and agent-tool boundaries being extended.
